lines: After being rammed into a large tree, the demon spat up blood and passed out.
I (the boar) had charged with all my might and sent the last demon standing in our way flying.
Phew! I don't know if it's good or bad, but I'm getting better at using the boar body...
I mumbled and gave my body a shake.
No, it was definitely not a good thing.
Oops, I can't just be standing around here. Where's Asagi-san...?
When I turned around, I found Asagi-san and the demon girl called Felicia right in the heat of battle.
Hehehe♪ Something like that won't work on Felly.
Asagi-san's sharp kick was repelled by the dark aura enveloping the girl.
For now, it was an evenly matched battle.
The demon girl seemed to possess strength that rivaled that of the young Asagi-san.
Yeah... But she's a tough opponent.
Not letting her guard down, Asagi-san nodded to me.
You're also pretty strong, miss. Felly's heart hasn't raced like this in a while.
The girl flashed Asagi-san a mysterious smile.
Indeed... If we keep this up, then one of us will certainly die here.
But there'd be no sense in that. Won't you please let us pass?
Nope. Felly wants Mr. Boar over there.
Even if it might cost your life? Why?
Even then. There's something Felly wants to do no matter what.
Whatever it takes. Even if Felly has to kill every last person on Earthー
The girl whispered with a ghastly look on her face.
(A desire she's willing to go that far for...? What could this girl possibly want...?)
Oh, a call from papa!? Sorry, miss. Wait a sec.
The girl's face lit up and she pulled a smartphone out of her sleeve.
The girl paid no mind to the dumbfounded Asagi-san and started talking on the phone.
Yes, hello? It's Felly. C'mon, papa, you can't keep being a bother like this. It was just getting to the good part.
Huh? What's Felly doing? Playing tag with Mr. Boar.
If you catch Mr. Boar and kill him, your wish will become true or something like that. Yeah. Anything you wish for.
Eh? Because you promised you'd do hatsumode together today so Felly even made beautiful kimono...
But then you said you can't go because you're busy with work...
That's why Felly wanted to kill Mr. Boar so Felly could do hatsumode with you, papa... Huh? You'll go!? You don't have work anymore?
Whoa!? For real!? Yeah, let's go, let's go! Let's go right now!! OK, Felly is coming, papa♪
Asagi-san had watched the whole scene unfold with her mouth agape.
Oh! Sorry, miss. Felly doesn't need Mr. Boar anymore♪
Nope! Felly's busy, so gotta go! Do your best to not get caught, Mr. Boar♪
The girl said and cheerfully disappeared deeper into the forest.
Asagi and me (the boar) were left with the unconscious group of demons.
D-Don't ask me... Anyways, at least we made it through in one piece...
We nodded to each other, our mixed feelings showing on our faces, and then resumed our pursuit of the lucky boar.
